create_GemmaTokenizer: create a GemmaTokenizer instance with default special tokens and BPE model backed by tokenizers
build_GemmaTokenizer_custom_vocab: build a GemmaTokenizer with a custom vocabulary dictionary mapping tokens to integer IDs
build_GemmaTokenizer_with_merges: build a GemmaTokenizer with custom BPE merge rules passed as a list of strings
configure_GemmaTokenizer_special_tokens: configure GemmaTokenizer with custom unk, bos, eos, pad, and mask token strings
create_GemmaTokenizer_padding_side: create a GemmaTokenizer with left padding side and model input names for input_ids and attention_mask
